title: In Libet's experiments the readiness potential precedes the reported urge to move

statements.text: Libet asked participants to move when they felt the urge and to report when they felt it. A readiness potential correlated with the movement began about 350 ms before the reported urge. Many have drawn the implication that the conscious urge comes too late to cause a movement the brain has already begun, and that the sense of the urge causing it is a causal illusion. Libet himself allowed for a veto after the urge.

sources.quote: the RP occurred about 350 ms earlier than the time that participants reported having the urge to move
The possibility of causal illusion, in turn, weakens the intuitive argument against epiphenomenalism
